notes: Coloured ticks on every app, checked automatically on your Mac: gold for an app signed by its known developer, green for signed and notarised, amber for unsigned or a broken signature, red for a possible fake. The ⓘ next to the app count explains them, and “Ask Apple about all apps…” checks every app with Apple. The Startup tab shows which app owns each item, finds items apps hide inside themselves or keep running from the Trash, and can stop them. New, off by default: when you drag an app to the Trash, Pangalin Uninstaller offers to remove its leftovers too. Apps from Homebrew can be removed with Homebrew, installer packages’ files and AI apps’ model folders show up in the review (unticked), apps left in the Trash with background items can be deleted from there, and an uninstall asks macOS to reset the app’s privacy permissions. It never offers Apple’s data or data an installed app still uses. New Appearance setting: Light, Dark or Match System. Updated Licence Terms (2026-10-10.14). Pangalin Uninstaller is completely free, with every feature included.
